claim_text: Explosions on the sun, with the sun described as doing something and going through a cycle that is different.
quote: He's talking about explosions on the sun
falsify_match: A solar event large enough to affect the earth, of the X-class carrington type.
falsify_miss: Solar activity stays within the normal range of the cycle. Solar cycle 25 was near its maximum when this was given, so heightened flare activity was expected and reported.

claim_text: Preachers seen preaching in the pulpit and going home right there in the middle of the manifestation of the harvest, on the Ananias and Sapphira pattern, as compromise is cleared out of the house of God.
quote: they'll be preaching and because of the manifestation
falsify_match: A preacher dying in the pulpit mid-service in a way publicly read as judgment.
falsify_miss: No such death. Deaths in the pulpit do occur occasionally from natural causes, so the judgment reading rather than the event is what would have to be established.
